body.zh-Hant: 長谷川清生於1883年，福井縣出身，1903年自海軍兵學校畢業。
body.en: Kiyoshi Hasegawa was born in 1883, came from Fukui Prefecture, and graduated from the Naval Academy in 1903.

citations.quote: 1883年生。福井県出身。1903年海兵卒
citations.evidenceNote: JACAR 人物解説欄（參考資料：秦郁彥《日本陸海軍總合事典》第2版）

body.zh-Hant: 1933年他擔任軍縮會議全權委員，1934年任海軍次官。1936年任第三艦隊司令長官，1937年兼任支那方面艦隊司令長官，1938年轉任橫濱鎮台長官。
body.en: In 1933 he was a plenipotentiary to the disarmament conference and in 1934 became Navy Vice-Minister. He became commander-in-chief of the Third Fleet in 1936, concurrently led the China Area Fleet in 1937, and in 1938 became commandant of the Yokohama Chindai (as worded in the source).

citations.evidenceNote: JACAR 人物解説欄（參考資料：秦郁彥《日本陸海軍總合事典》第2版）

body.zh-Hant: 1940年他任軍事參議官並兼台灣總督，1944年再任軍事參議官；最終軍階為海軍大將，1970年去世。
body.en: In 1940 he became Supreme Military Councillor and Governor-General of Taiwan, in 1944 again served as Councillor; his final rank was admiral, and he died in 1970.

body.zh-Hant: 長谷川清生於1883年5月7日，福井縣出身，1970年9月2日去世。他於明治36年自海軍兵學校第31期畢業，大正3年自海軍大學校畢業。昭和7年他被派往日內瓦軍縮會議。1934年任海軍次官，1936年任第三艦隊司令長官，1937年任支那方面艦隊兼第三艦隊司令長官。
body.en: Hasegawa Kiyoshi was born on 7 May 1883, came from Fukui Prefecture, and died on 2 September 1970. He graduated from the Naval Academy (31st class) in the Meiji 36 year and the Naval War College in Taisho 3. In Showa 7 he was sent to the Geneva disarmament conference. He became Vice-Minister of the Navy in 1934, Third Fleet commander in 1936 and China Area Fleet commander concurrently commanding the Third Fleet in 1937.

body.zh-Hant: 1940年他任軍事參議官並兼台灣總督，1944年再任軍事參議官。他的台灣總督任期自1940年11月27日起至1944年12月30日止，後任為安藤利吉。
body.en: In Showa 13 he became Commander of the Yokosuka Naval District and in Showa 14 was promoted admiral. In 1940 he became Supreme War Councillor and Governor-General of Taiwan, and in 1944 again Supreme War Councillor. His term as Governor-General ran from 27 November 1940 to 30 December 1944, and Andō Rikichi succeeded him.
